title: centaurea dufourii var. humilis
intro: Centaurea dufourii var. humilis, commonly known as Dufour's Knapweed, is a flowering plant species in the aster family that is native to the Mediterranean region. This plant has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including inflammation, pain, and respiratory problems, due to its potential health benefits, which include antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Centaurea dufourii var. humilis are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit sedative and antispasmodic effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
